description: Where a tenant's primary unit (unitNumber label, unitId, unitArea) goes when one of their units is freed. Run by functions-tenant-lifecycle/src/test/moveOutTenantFields.test.ts (primaryMovesOnRelease, primaryUnitAfterRelease) and test/tenant_unit_id_test.dart (TenantService.primaryMovesOnRelease, primaryUnitAfterRelease). 'to' is the unit it moves to, null when it does not move or no kept unit has a number.

cases.name: label names the freed unit, no unitId: first kept unit with a number
label names the freed unit, no unitId: a kept unit with the same number first
unitId is the freed unit: moves to the kept unit with the same number
unitId is a kept unit numbered like the freed one: it stays
unitId is a kept unit, another unit freed: it stays
no unitId, label names a kept unit: it stays
unitId names a unit they no longer hold, label names the freed unit: moves
unitId is the freed unit, label names another number: first kept unit with a number
no label and no unitId: nothing moves
kept units without numbers: moves, to none
